title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30

ai_review.summary: Terrific performance with an imaginative second set despite a washed‑out, rough tape.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the show as terrific and full of color, especially noting the inventive second set that kept the crowd enthralled. The recording is described as a rough, washed‑out nth‑generation tape with occasional drop‑outs, but the musical excitement outweighs the technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong show quality (high energy, imaginative playing) offset by modest recording issues; two detailed reviews give a reliable but limited data set.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape is rough in spots and washed‑out (nth‑generation tape), but still listenable for the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted as especially colorful and imaginative; overall flow described as terrific.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh's electric bass playing is noted for its imagination and color.
